calc.title: Rusuite Calc
calc.shortDescription: Free, offline spreadsheets that open and save Excel (.xlsx) files
calc.subtitle: Spreadsheets, offline
calc.fullDescription:
Rusuite Calc is a free spreadsheet app for your phone and tablet. Open an Excel workbook (.xlsx), calculate, format and save it again – without an account and without an internet connection.

• Excel-compatible formulas, including dynamic arrays, with formula editing by pointing
• Charts, number formats, cell styles, conditional formatting and fill
• Sort, filter, tables and PivotTables

• Free and open source (MIT) – no ads, no account, no tracking
• Works offline: your documents stay on your device
• Opens and saves Excel, Word and PowerPoint files
• Available in 24 languages

New in 3.1415
• Phone and tablet apps with a touch-friendly layout
• Touch editing: selection handles, pinch to zoom, gestures
• Export as PDF
• Signed desktop apps for Windows, macOS and Linux
